risk_register.name: Replay attack on receipt verification
risk_register.mitigation: JWS signature + nonce + server timestamp window + unique index on (platform, platform_transaction_id)

risk_register.name: Cross-account purchase abuse
risk_register.mitigation: Bind Apple/Google account to internal user_id at first purchase; reject mismatched account_id on subsequent calls

risk_register.name: Refund-then-spend exploit (revoke after gacha pull)
risk_register.mitigation: Refund flow never reverses gacha outcomes; track refund_status on purchase_ledger; flag accounts with refund>spend ratio for manual review

risk_register.name: Hidden odds non-compliance
risk_register.mitigation: Loot box odds disclosure linked from every summon_pack shop card and in banner

risk_register.name: P2W combat purchase pressure
risk_register.mitigation: Hard family ban: no stat boost, no artifact, no premium/targeted sigilli, no pity skip in catalog

risk_register.name: Server merge / multishard wallet split inconsistency
risk_register.mitigation: paid currency account-wide; free currency server-bound; document split in SLC merge tooling

risk_register.name: Sandbox leakage to production fulfillment
risk_register.mitigation: Feature flags IAP_FULFILLMENT_CANARY_ONLY=true + IAP_GLOBAL_DISABLED=true until release gate; sandbox accounts strictly internal

risk_register.name: Real product IDs leaking into code before catalog stage
risk_register.mitigation: Static validator forbids real product id patterns in product code (only mock.divinewaifus.* allowed in this pack)

risk_register.name: User confusion between paid and free Divine Crystals
risk_register.mitigation: Tesoreria shows split; banner conversion modal shows split; homepage shows unified count but conversion is transparent

risk_register.name: Suite stale-push of validator runner
risk_register.mitigation: Tripled-sentinel strategy (top tag + inline sentinel + proof marker JSON separate directory)

compliance_checklist.item: Apple StoreKit IAP only for digital content on iOS
Google Play Billing only for digital content on Google Play
Real, complete price in local currency at point of purchase
Loot box odds disclosure visible (per banner card + per summon_pack shop card)
Refund / restore purchases UX available at Stage 8 of roadmap
GDPR / CCPA wallet data export + paid history retention
No dark patterns / no pressure timers < 60s / no surprise random charge

future_stages_remaining: INTERNAL_PURCHASE_FULFILLMENT_CANARY (same pattern as artifact Stage 8: sfqa + test only)
